one_line: Tang-era monk-scholar whose overland pilgrimage to India reshaped Buddhist learning and opened new channels of information along the Silk Road.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, slim but travel-hardened build, with the wiry stamina of someone who has walked thousands of li.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, thoughtful look; warm light-olive complexion from long sun exposure; straight brows, sharp black eyes with focused intensity; a small, neat nose; trimmed mustache and short goatee; default expression serene but alert, as if constantly observing and memorizing details.
appearance.hair: Black hair shaved in a Tang Buddhist monk tonsure, leaving only a narrow dark fringe just above the ears and at the back; no loose hair; simple dark-brown cloth headband wrapped low around the crown to keep sweat off his brow, knotted at the back with short tails.
appearance.costume: Layered Tang-dynasty monk’s garb adapted for long-distance travel: inner layer a plain, long-sleeved, ankle-length robe of undyed light-beige hemp, belted with a narrow dark-brown cloth sash; over this, a saffron-ochre kashaya-style patchwork robe draped over the left shoulder and under the right arm, edges carefully folded and secured so it never slips, its fabric visibly worn and slightly frayed at the hem; over his shoulders and upper torso a travel-stained, muted gray-blue wool cloak, clasped at the right collarbone with a simple round wooden toggle, practical for cold passes in Central Asia; feet in sturdy dark-brown leather travel boots, laced at the front, dusted from the road; on his left wrist, a single strand of wooden prayer beads wrapped twice; across his chest and back runs a thick, dark-brown leather strap supporting his load; hanging at his side is a small, rectangular, dark-red cloth satchel with subtle woven cloud patterns in a slightly darker tone, used for important texts; overall silhouette modest and fully covered, with fabrics falling in straight, simple folds that show both Chinese and Indian monastic influences.
appearance.signature: A tall, plain wooden monk’s staff (khakkhara-style) with a simple iron finial at the top—only two small rings so it’s quieter on the Silk Road caravans—worn smooth where his hand grips it, and a rolled, tightly bound bundle of palm-leaf and paper manuscripts lashed to the leather strap on his back, the scroll bundle wrapped in a faded dark-yellow cloth cover marked by a single stitched circle pattern.

ref_desc: Xuanzang is a slim early-30s Tang monk with a light-olive oval face, shaved tonsure with a dark-brown headband, wearing a light-beige inner robe, saffron-ochre kashaya, gray-blue travel cloak, dark-brown boots and strap, dark-red satchel, and carrying a plain khakkhara staff plus a dark-yellow-wrapped manuscript bundle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Xuanzang as a dignified Tang-era monk-scholar: a slim, early-30s man with an oval, light-olive face, sharp black eyes, straight brows, a small trimmed mustache and short goatee, his head shaved in a Buddhist tonsure with only a narrow dark fringe above the ears, and a simple dark-brown cloth headband tied at the back. Show him in layered, modest travel clothing: a long-sleeved, ankle-length inner robe of undyed light-beige hemp belted with a narrow dark-brown sash; over it a saffron-ochre patchwork kashaya draped over the left shoulder and under the right arm; on top a muted gray-blue wool cloak fastened at the right collarbone with a round wooden toggle. Give him sturdy dark-brown leather travel boots and a thick dark-brown leather strap crossing his chest to support a rolled bundle of manuscripts on his back, wrapped in a faded dark-yellow cloth with a single stitched circle motif. At his side hangs a small rectangular dark-red cloth satchel with subtle woven cloud patterns, and a simple wooden prayer-bead bracelet coils twice around his left wrist. Place his plain wooden monk’s staff (khakkhara) in his right hand, topped with a modest iron finial with only two small rings; the staff should look well-worn where he grips it. Use a restrained palette of saffron ochre, light beige, muted gray-blue, dark brown, and dark red, and present him from head to toe with clear views of his face, hairstyle, robes, cloak, boots, satchel, staff, and manuscript bundle so the character can be redrawn consistently.
